lines: Here are FOUR MORE basketball rules every player needs to understand.
You've got eight seconds to get the ball into the frontcourt...
and when you're dribbling, BOTH feet AND the ball need to cross!
Once your team has control up front, you can't send the ball back over the line and get it back.
Stay in there for more than three seconds on offense while your team controls the ball?
And this last one catches players out.
The shot is coming down, still above the rim...
